answer: Here is a specific defense: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. An identity earns only when its signal recurs, its thread survives audit, and a inlet from an unlinked peer confirms it.
